question: Who becomes free from bondage after six months of practice while wearing an ochre robe?
premises: Six months of practice frees one from bondage.
The practitioner wears an ochre robe.
inference: The verse links six months of practice with freedom from bondage for the ochre-robed practitioner.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical case of ṣaṇmāsād is inferred.
plain_english: Whoever practices for six months in an ochre robe becomes free from bondage.
